cases.name: real BRDP-S1-00507: <rules> around a structureObjectRule and a nonContextRule
cases.input:
<rules>
<structureObjectRule>
            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//randomList//randomList</objectPath>
            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00507. A <randomList> must not be nested inside another <randomList> -- the default prefix pf02 is always used, without nesting. </objectUse>
          </structureObjectRule>
<nonContextRule>
          <simplePara>BRDP-S1-00507. Decide whether to use a consistent set of prefixes for random list throughout the project. </simplePara>
          <simplePara>Decision made by Project. Nested randomList should be avoided. The listItemPrefix attribute shall always be the default value, which is pf02.</simplePara>
        </nonContextRule>
</rules>

          </structureObjectRule>
<nonContextRule>
          <simplePara>BRDP-S1-00507. Decide whether to use a consistent set of prefixes for random list throughout the project. </simplePara>
          <simplePara>Decision made by Project. Nested randomList should be avoided. The listItemPrefix attribute shall always be the default value, which is pf02.</simplePara>
        </nonContextRule>
